headline: UAE Quits OPEC Amid Escalating Iran War and Hormuz Crisis, Threatening Global Energy Stability
summary: The United Arab Emirates' departure from OPEC significantly destabilizes the global oil cartel and escalates geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, particularly around the critical Strait of Hormuz. This move, coupled with an ongoing Iran war, portends extreme volatility in energy prices and poses a direct threat to global supply chain logistics reliant on stable oil flows.
